purpose: Record unresolved case-law searches transparently when primary-source discovery does not yet establish suitable authorities.
search_scope: Registration of Title Act 1964 registry-map and boundary provisions
Registration of Title Act 1964 possessory-title provisions

searches: registry map boundary Registration of Title Act
section 85 Registration of Title Act boundary
possessory title Registration of Title Act

handling_rule: No case authority is invented, inferred, or promoted from an unverified secondary reference merely to fill a research gap.
next_research_methods: Search the Irish Legal Information Institute and other authoritative case repositories for candidate judgments.
Cross-check every candidate against the actual judgment.
Use cited authorities within reviewed judgments to expand the primary-case network.
Record negative searches and unresolved gaps rather than treating absence of search results as absence of case law.
publication_effect: Only propositions dependent on unresolved judicial interpretation remain blocked; statutory propositions are not downgraded solely because a separate case-law search is incomplete.
guardrails: No claim that no case law exists.
No secondary summary treated as a judgment.
No case-law gap converted into a legal conclusion.
